ambience.description: A wave swells in on the inhale and recedes on the exhale.
ambience.name: Ocean Waves

ambience.description: A far-off ocean at night: a low, steady wash that breathes softly in and out, darker and gentler than Ocean Waves.
ambience.name: Distant Surf (night)

ambience.description: A warm summer night on a porch: a soft, steady wash of warm air that breathes gently, with no chill in it.
ambience.name: Summer Porch

ambience.description: Steady rainfall that softly intensifies with each breath.
ambience.name: Gentle Rain

ambience.description: Wind moving through trees, sweeping side to side.
ambience.name: Forest Wind

ambience.description: A bright babbling stream over rocks.
ambience.name: Mountain Stream

ambience.description: A deep, slow low-end rumble felt more than heard.
ambience.name: Distant Thunder

ambience.description: Broad rainfall with a hint of low rumble underneath.
ambience.name: Soft Rainstorm

ambience.description: The warm, low patter of rain drumming on a roof overhead.
ambience.name: Rain on a Roof

ambience.description: Steady pink noise - balanced, soothing masking.
ambience.name: Pink Noise

ambience.description: Steady brown noise - deep and soft, good for sleep.
ambience.name: Brown Noise

ambience.description: Soft pink noise swelling gently at ~0.8 Hz - a slow, even rise and fall to drift off to.
ambience.name: Deep Sleep (Pink Noise)

ambience.description: A warm, distant hubbub - soft background chatter of a room.
ambience.name: Cafe Murmur

ambience.description: Rain pattering on taut canvas - cosy under a tent.
ambience.name: Rain on a Tent

ambience.description: A steady wind sighing through pine boughs, drifting side to side.
ambience.name: Wind in Pines

ambience.description: A smooth, steady fan / white-noise machine for masking.
ambience.name: Fan (White Noise)

ambience.description: A metal bowl struck softly now and then, ringing slowly down.
ambience.name: Singing Bowl

ambience.description: Scattered chimes drifting in on the breeze, in a gentle pentatonic.
ambience.name: Wind Chimes

ambience.description: A soft pink-noise wash that pulses gently, about 48 a minute - an unhurried rhythm to drift off to.
ambience.name: Slow-Wave Pulse

breath.description: Low, warm, breathy. A slow grounding breath.
breath.name: Deep Calm

breath.description: The throaty, oceanic yoga breath made in the back of the throat.
breath.name: Ocean Breath (Ujjayi)

breath.description: Airy and gentle, like a quiet sigh close to the ear.
breath.name: Soft Whisper

breath.description: Very soft and warm - made for drifting off to sleep.
breath.name: Sleepy Warm

breath.description: An ocean tide: the in-breath rolls in and swells, the out-breath draws back, hissing bright through wet pebbles.
breath.name: Tide & Pebbles

breath.description: Distant surf: a deep, dark sea hush that rises softly and sinks away on the out-breath.
breath.name: Deep Surf

breath.description: Soft, fine rain: a gentle high patter that fills out a little as you breathe out.
breath.name: Spring Rain

breath.description: Wind through the pines: a gust rises as you breathe in and sighs away as you breathe out, drifting from side to side.
breath.name: Pine Wind

breath.description: A warm fire: the in-breath fans a low roar brighter, the out-breath lets it settle back to a glow.
breath.name: Ember Glow

breath.description: A vast, airy wind among the stars: high and wide, drifting slowly across a great dark space.
breath.name: Cosmic Wind

breath.description: The hush of falling snow: a soft, almost-silent high stillness on the still air of a winter night.
breath.name: Snowfall Hush
